title: The Reddish-Black Pig
text: “If anything, ‘fairy’ would be more accurate, nano. Gaelion’s pretty sure that’s the official setting, nano.”
“Gaelion-san. You’re not Rafumi-san, so please don’t say pointless things.”
“Ugh, seriously… I have no idea how to cure Itsuki’s sickness.”
“Isn’t he basically the Demon Lord of Bows at this point?”
“Don’t say that out loud, he’ll take it as a compliment. Right, Ren?”
“Understood… well, it’s only natural those two won’t be forgiven. Both the king and queen seem to feel the same way—am I wrong?”
The queen hid her mouth—no, her entire face—behind her fan, pressing a hand to her forehead.

“Those who have seized the castle without any right to it have no cause worth speaking of. At this point I would not even deign to call them people. I only hope for divine punishment from the gods of the Three Heroes Church upon them.”
“Now that’s a fine bit of irony. Official divine punishment, delivered by the very gods they claim to worship. Fitting, I’d say.”
“Hmph! As if we would ever lose to false gods like you lot!”
Honestly, they really do commit to the bit, I say. It was a weapon I’d grown embarrassingly familiar with by now.
“Fuhahaha! We shall show you true justice and righteous cause! I, the false king, and my beloved wife who sides with the Demon Lord of Shields! Prepare to be thoroughly humbled!”
The queen and Trash both shifted their gazes as if steeling themselves for battle. It seemed the shock of the earlier footage had, for the moment, been swept conveniently under the rug.
“Bu-bu-bu-buhii!”
Then the reddish-black pig-like thing took a step forward and started spouting something. The queen hid her mouth behind her fan and glared coldly.
“And what of it, that royal blood happens to flow through your veins?”
“Bu-buhi-bu-bu!”

“I see… so that is the Three Heroes Church’s justification for claiming the castle as its own. How amusing—someone who renounced their succession rights to join the clergy now wishes to play king with such a shameless face.”
“So the plan all along was for the Three Heroes Church to seize Melromarc for itself, setting the wife aside as pretense…”

They seemed to be having a fine time of it, the queen and Trash taking their turn to speak. As for me, that thing was nothing more than a pig that had been possessed by the Crimson Swine, wasn’t it? Rival? No, was I wrong about that?
“…Even without that evil spirit possessing it, the insides are apparently just as rotten. Impressive, in a way, nano.”
“You know something, Gaelion-chan?”
“I know too, indeed. That one.”
“Gaelion saw it during a loop. Back then it got possessed by some other guy and rampaged in a situation just like this one, nano. Spear Hero, no need to go into detail, nano.”
“Why not, I wonder?”
“Because it’ll get complicated, nano! Naofumi agrees, nano!”
“Ah, right. Got it. Motoyasu-kun, no need to elaborate. Do you even understand what it’s saying in the first place?”

Curse you, Rival… But truthfully, I had no idea what the reddish-black pig was saying, indeed. All I knew was that it had once been possessed by the ghost of the Crimson Swine. And apparently, even without possession, its personality was much the same.

“Joining the clergy, huh. It’s the classic ‘I don’t want to die over succession disputes so I renounce my claim’ story, but seeing the Church twist that into a justification just shows how thoroughly it’s being exploited. Kind of makes you wonder why we even bothered overlooking it.”
“There’s no doubt the Three Heroes Church has gone completely off the rails. And you have no claim to succession, need I remind you?”
“Bu-buboo! Buhi-buhi-buhi-buhii!”
“Say whatever you like. I am the queen, the representative of Melromarc. I believe there’s nothing more to discuss.”
“Don’t you dare cut this conversation short on your own terms!”
“That’s right! This girl is my darling adopted daughter! Neither Malty nor Melty were fit to be queen of this nation, which is precisely why I decided to devote everything to her!”
“Don’t you dare spout such nonsense with my face! I never acknowledged that woman!”
The real Trash was absolutely livid, indeed. His fake counterpart doted on that pig with all his heart.

“How should I put it… looking just at the situation, these guys feel like something out of a shoujo manga. Over there—on the enemy side—I guess it goes like: exiled or fleeing from power, joins the clergy, then all sorts of drama, and comes back for a grand return.”

“Naofumi-san, you really do have a wide range of interests, don’t you. I didn’t know such things existed. By the way, mind if I step in? Honestly, I’d like to shut every single one of those noisy mouths up already. That rabbit guy keeps trying to hold me back, and it’s getting annoying.”
“Iwatani-sama asked me to. I’m making sure nobody skips the movie!”
Once he’d gone full halo-mode, Itsuki had ended up in Rabbit Guy’s arms, after all.
“…Haa.”
Father let out a deep sigh after listening to their so-called justifications and grand causes and all that nonsense.
“Fufufufu! Enjoy your arrogance while it lasts! Don’t think you can win against this legendary weapon!”

And with that, they raised the copy weapon that had been out for a while now—the one the queen and Trash had been wary of. If they truly believed they could win with that thing, there was simply no helping them, indeed.

“I wasn’t planning on negotiating, but their logic is so nonsensical it’s exhausting just to listen to, and Itsuki over here is way too fired up, and honestly the whole thing’s just a mess in general.”
Is this also because of our own past misdeeds…? Father lamented, sighing.
“Given the circumstances, nano, it can’t be helped this time, nano. Bow Hero saw way too much of Melromarc’s darkness and went wild, nano.”
“Yeah, that’s fine by me. By the way, we’re about to start, right?”
Itsuki wore the grin of a hunter eyeing its prey, indeed.
“Itsuki… taking down scum that awful practically counts as justice at this point, doesn’t it?”
“It’s just a result, that’s all.”
“What do you think, Theo? Feels like this is the final showdown.”
“Should be, but… somehow it doesn’t feel very satisfying, justice-wise. Maybe it’s this world’s Bow Hero’s fault?”
“Who knows. Well… if we take them alive here, they’d probably end up wishing they were dead instead. Branded as traitors to the nation, execution’s pretty much unavoidable.”
Father turned to the queen, who nodded in agreement.
“Knowing Itsuki, he’d probably just capture them ‘on the record’ and then quietly bury them in the dark anyway.”
“If that’s what you want, I’m happy to oblige.”
“I don’t want that.”
Ren shot down Itsuki’s suggestion, indeed.
“Well, honestly, I don’t really want to give this kind of order, but… the least we can do is finish it quickly. Keeping them alive won’t lead anywhere good, and we can’t afford any more victims.”
Permission from Father, granted, indeed!
“Try it if you think you can! Take this!”
Crackling with obvious charge, the new pope launched Brionac at us from the copy weapon.
“Hoh! Indeed.”
I smacked it aside with a solid strike. With a whoosh, it tore clean through the wall of the throne room, punching out a hole.
“Fuhahahaha—wha!?”
“Bu-buhi!?”
“W-what!? What is the meaning of this!?”
Even the fake Trash forgot to keep up his Trash act, utterly dumbfounded, indeed.
“That’s absurd! Then take this!”
This time it was Phoenix Blade, was it? A skill recreating a sword technique came flying at us.
“Hmph.”
Ren sliced through the incoming firebird and scattered it to nothing, indeed.
“No need to even bother with a skill.”
“That’s absurd!?”
As if for good measure, they switched to a bow and drew it taut. Some kind of glowing arrow came flying out. I forget what skill that was supposed to be, indeed.
“Heh heh… is that really all you’ve got?”
Itsuki, sneering, barely even drew back his toy-looking bow before loosing an arrow with a casual little *pew*, blasting straight through the incoming glowing arrow.
“How laughable. You seemed so confident, and this is what you bring out? Guess I’ll go all out then, shall Iiiiiii!”
It was obvious at a glance that Itsuki, itching to shoot something down properly, was about to shift his weapon into the Cursed Bow of Wrath.
“Wai—!? What is this guy about to do!?”
Rabbit Guy, holding him, cried out. Flames and black smoke had already begun billowing up with an ominous rumble.
